title: sambucus racemosa var. pendula
intro: Sambucus racemosa var. pendula, commonly known as the American elderberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Adoxaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including colds, flu, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sambucus racemosa var. pendula include antiviral, antihistamine, and expectorant actions, which help to relieve symptoms such as congestion, cough, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
